content.short: Tonkeeper is the leading non-custodial wallet for the TON ecosystem, featuring the fee-abstracting Battery.
content.description: Tonkeeper is the premier self-custodial digital asset manager built natively for The Open Network, designed to provide a secure gateway to the decentralized web. The wallet supports a wide range of assets—including Toncoin, Jettons, and NFTs—within an intuitive interface. A standout innovation is Tonkeeper Battery, a fee-abstraction mechanism that allows users to pay transaction costs using any supported asset. Deeply integrated with the TON ecosystem, Tonkeeper features a built-in dApp browser and secure staking tools, enabling participants to manage their portfolios with ease.
